concrete_changes: Retained focused coach/cue/debrief comment. Its conditional language proposes an assessment inquiry; it does not report a tested outcome.
voice_preserved: Genre-specific register, supplied premise, existing affiliation and source scope preserved; new imagined scenes remain labelled. No invented autobiography.
unresolved_findings: Requires fresh review of exact destination, parent discussion/community rules and account before any delivery; no inherited queue approval transfers.
source_coverage: Complete supplied draft and current writer contract reviewed; no new independent live-account, product-runtime, clinical or historical verification claimed.
publication_state: Separate local review candidate; no source, queue approval, delivery or published copy changed.

material_claim_treatments.treatment: Existing product/author/affiliation facts retain supplied scope; a style pass is not new runtime, identity or historical verification.
Editorial metaphors and proposed inquiry methods remain interpretations. Imagined examples are identified and no lived result is added.

independent_review.scope: Complete paired textual coverage plus explicitly recorded final changed-span/context readbacks. Source literature is not certified.
